lessons.title: Your first team meeting
lessons.goal: I can talk about a team meeting and say what is on the agenda.

newItems.definition: A list of things to talk about in a meeting.
newItems.example: The first item on the agenda is the new project.

newItems.definition: The written notes of what was said in a meeting.
newItems.example: Anna writes the minutes of our meetings.

newItems.definition: The reason why something is done.
newItems.example: What is the purpose of this meeting?

newItems.definition: To start something, such as a meeting or a project.
newItems.example: Let us kick off the meeting at nine.

newItems.definition: Planned to be talked about in a meeting.
newItems.example: The new office is on the agenda today.

mainWord.definition: A list of things to talk about in a meeting.
mainWord.example: The first item on the agenda is the new project.

lessons.title: Share your ideas in a meeting
lessons.goal: I can share my ideas in a meeting and say what I think.

newItems.definition: To think of many ideas quickly with other people.

newItems.definition: To give your ideas or work to help a group.

newItems.definition: To agree with an idea and help it.

newItems.definition: In my opinion; the way I see it.

mainWord.definition: To think of many ideas quickly with other people.

lessons.title: Agree and disagree politely
lessons.goal: I can agree and disagree politely in a meeting.

newItems.definition: A way of thinking about something.
newItems.example: I understand your viewpoint.

newItems.definition: To stop someone while they are speaking.
newItems.example: Please do not interrupt Anna.

newItems.definition: I agree with you completely.
newItems.example: We need more time. I couldn't agree more.

newItems.definition: That is reasonable; I accept your point.
newItems.example: You are busy. Fair enough.

newItems.definition: In the end, when you think about it.
newItems.example: After all, we all want the same thing.

mainWord.definition: A way of thinking about something.

Anna, what is your viewpoint?
My viewpoint is different. I think we can start today.
Please do not interrupt Anna. Let her finish.
You are right. Fair enough. After all, we all want the same thing.

We need more time.'

lessons.speakingSample: I understand your viewpoint. I couldn't agree more with you. We need more time. Please do not interrupt Anna. Let her finish. Fair enough. After all, we all want the same thing. I like to listen to my team. I learn a lot from my team. We talk about the plan every week.

lessons.title: Take notes and follow up
